hints: Friends must be placed on opposite teams, so assign one of two colors along each edge.
Start a BFS/DFS in every component and propagate the opposite color.
An edge joining equal colors proves the component cannot be split into two teams.
analogy: Alternate two colors across each friendship; a conflict means the friendships form an odd loop.
example: For a triangle, alternating teams around the loop returns to the starting pupil with the opposite team requirement, so it is impossible.
correctness: Any valid split must give adjacent endpoints different colors; propagation assigns all forced relative colors, and a conflict is a proof no assignment exists.
algorithm: Color every component with BFS/DFS. For each edge (u,v), require color[v]=3-color[u]; print IMPOSSIBLE on conflict, otherwise print all assigned 1/2 labels.
